headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <Agent Pass>. Obtain a pass at https://agent-pass.turingcorp.net (self-service signup, email verification, then top up). A pass is valid for 7 days and can be re-rolled.

agent_pass.description: Your TuringCorp Agent Pass. Sign up and top up at https://agent-pass.turingcorp.net; if a call is refused as an invalid credential, sign in there again and re-roll the pass.
